name: gizza-ai/photo-filter-presets
summary: Apply a photo filter preset (sepia, vintage, warm, cool, noir, and more) to an image.

tool.description: Apply a named photographic filter preset to an image at the given URL. Presets: sepia, vintage, warm, cool, noir, grayscale, vivid, invert, fade. Use when the user asks to add a filter, tint, or vintage/sepia/black-and-white look to a photo.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to an image (PNG, JPEG, or WebP).

preset.description: Filter preset to apply. Default: sepia.
